name: Composite Cross Domain Variant 5
task:
Please complete the following four-stage multi-domain task.

=== Stage 1: Information Extraction ===
A tech company's quarterly (18 pages): $50M revenue, 35% margin, 4 product lines. Investment options: Cloud ($8M, 40% growth), Mobile ($5M, 25% growth), AI ($10M, 50% growth), Security ($3M, 15% growth). Budget: $15M.

=== Stage 2: Financial Analysis ===
Calculate NPV of the investment.

=== Stage 3: Resource Allocation ===
Optimize budget allocation.

=== Stage 4: Decision ===
Recommend the best course of action.

subtasks.name: Report data extraction and information retrieval
